summary: Checkout errors from database connection pool exhaustion, with a fresh deploy that looks guilty.

alert.title: CheckoutApiDbPoolExhausted
alert.description: checkout-api: HikariCP pool 'orders-db' at 50/50 active connections on all instances; checkout 5xx rate 18% (threshold 2%).

hypotheses.deploy: The checkout-api v2.14.0 deploy introduced a regression that exhausts the pool.
hypotheses.slow_queries: Queries to orders-db became slow, so connections are held longer and the pool fills up.
hypotheses.leak: Connections are leaked: checked out and never returned to the pool.
hypotheses.traffic: A traffic increase exceeds what the pool can serve.
hypotheses.config: A configuration change lowered the pool's capacity.

deploys.describe: Recent deploys across services, with change summaries.
deploys.result: 14:02 UTC checkout-api v2.14.0 rolled to 6 of 12 instances (canary; the other 6 still run v2.13.4). Change summary: 'Add loyalty-points lookup to checkout; adds one SELECT against orders-db per checkout.' Also: search-api config change at 13:30, internal-admin deploy at 11:00.

errors_by_version.describe: checkout-api 5xx rate split by application version.
errors_by_version.result: 14:00-14:10 UTC. v2.13.4 (6 instances): 5xx 17.8%, first errors 14:06. v2.14.0 (6 instances): 5xx 18.3%, first errors 14:06. Before 14:05 both versions were under 0.3%.

pool_usage.describe: Per-instance connection pool usage for the orders-db pool.
pool_usage.result: All 12 checkout-api instances (both versions) at 50/50 active connections since 14:06 UTC. Threads waiting for a connection: 0 before 14:05, 180-240 per instance after 14:06.

pool_config.describe: Effective connection pool settings per version and when they last changed.
pool_config.result: maximumPoolSize=50, connectionTimeout=3000ms on both v2.13.4 and v2.14.0. Last change: 2026-08-02.

request_rate.describe: checkout-api request rate over the last hour.
request_rate.result: Requests per second: 13:50 1,180; 14:00 1,195; 14:05 1,210; 14:10 1,190. Same-hour average over the last 4 weeks: 1,240.

connection_lifecycle.describe: Connection checkout vs return counts and hold times for the orders-db pool.
connection_lifecycle.result: Connections returned per second track connections checked out per second throughout (ratio 0.99-1.00). Median connection hold time rose from 45ms (14:00) to 2.3s (14:08). No connection held longer than 30s. Leak detection (threshold 60s) fired 0 times.

query_latency.describe: orders-db query latency seen by checkout-api, with the slowest statements.
query_latency.result: p50/p99: 14:00 8ms/40ms; 14:03 120ms/650ms; 14:04 900ms/2.1s; 14:08 1.4s/3.0s. Slowest statements: 'UPDATE orders SET status = ... WHERE id = ...' and 'SELECT ... FROM orders WHERE id = ... FOR UPDATE'. The new loyalty-points SELECT (v2.14.0 only): p99 12ms.

db_lock_waits.describe: orders-db lock wait time and the sessions holding blocking locks.
db_lock_waits.result: Average lock wait: under 5ms until 14:02 UTC, 1.8s by 14:05. Top blocking session: pid 48213, user batch_svc, running since 14:01: 'UPDATE orders SET archived = true WHERE created_at < now() - interval ''2 years'''. It holds row locks on the orders table.

batch_jobs.describe: Scheduled and manually triggered jobs that touch orders-db.
batch_jobs.result: orders-archive: started 14:01 UTC, still running. Normally scheduled at 02:00 UTC; manually triggered today by the data-platform team. No other jobs on orders-db in the last 24h.

db_resources.describe: orders-db CPU, memory and disk I/O.
db_resources.result: CPU 35% (14:00) to 38% (14:08). Memory and disk I/O within normal range. Replication lag under 1s.

checkout_logs.result: 4,812 lines matching 'Connection is not available, request timed out after 3000ms' from both v2.13.4 and v2.14.0 instances, first at 14:06:04. No new exception types in v2.14.0.

orders_db_logs.result: QUERY FAILED: log search timed out after 30s. 0 lines returned. This is a failed query, not an empty result.

payment_latency.result: payment-service p99 latency rose from 210ms to 3.4s at 14:07 UTC. payment-service calls checkout-api for order status. No payment-service deploys this week.

search_cache.result: Cache hit ratio dropped from 94% to 61% at 14:00 UTC after the scheduled hourly cache flush and recovered to 93% by 14:06.

cert_warnings.result: TLS certificate for internal-admin.corp expires in 12 days. No other warnings.
